[step] When you are deciding to start an exercise program, you should talk to your doctor and/or a physical therapist about your plans. Ending1: No matter what your physical fitness level is, you can be more active and get on a program to strengthen your body. A physical therapist can help you come up with an exercise plan to help reduce your risk of falling. Ending2: [substeps] Your physical therapist may also be able to suggest other exercise programs that you could try. If you want to start a new exercise program, discuss the options the therapist has expressed with you. Ending3: You may also want to consider home safety measures before starting the program. Taking steps to make sure your home is not subjected to any hazards can be a great way to improve your health and minimize the risk of falling at any point in your exercising regimen. Ending4: [substeps] The therapist can help you define your fitness goals and form a plan that will be convenient for you while you exercise. The physical therapist can help you describe your exercises to her and other physical therapists so that they can give you guidance.

Please choose the correct ending to complete the given sentence: Youth: [header] How to dress casually [title] Avoid clothes that are too tight. [step] You don't have to wear clothes that are super-baggy, but tight-fitting clothes can make you look uncomfortable, defeating the purpose of casual wear. [substeps] Form-fitting dresses or tight pants are more suitable for a night at the club than a casual day spent relaxing.

Ending1: Additionally, try to wear clothes that are designed for casual outdoor activities. For example, a dress without shirts can look ideal in an air conditioned parking lot, while a shirt without a jacket will look a bit inappropriate indoors. Ending2: Clothes which are highly structured, such as garments with stiff collars or strong shoulders, usually come across as dressy. [title] Slip on your favorite comfy jeans. Ending3: Go for a two-piece dress that hugs you in at least your waist, accentuates your sex appeal and offers some padding to your butt and hips. Solid black fabrics instead of dark denim are more appropriate for light, casual compression clothing. Ending4: Just make sure they are not tight enough that they slide up on your legs, or that they don't hang down too high on your belly button. Choose a bottom that you like and avoid material that will cinch at your waist.

Answer format: ending1/ending2/ending3/ending4

questions.instruction:
Please choose the correct ending to complete the given sentence: Health: [header] How to increase alertness [title] Get enough sleep at night. [step] Good sleep is the single most important factor in increasing alertness. Although the amount each person requires varies, the national sleep foundation suggests 8 to 10 hours a night for teenagers and 7 to 9 hours for adults.

Ending1: [substeps] The majority of adults need 13 or more hours a night for a minimum of 13 nights. It is recommended that teens (8 or 9 months) get 11 to 15 hours every night for the first 2 days of the week, in addition to 8 to 12 hours every night for the first four days. Ending2: Young adults under age 65 (or older) should aim for seven to nine hours of quality sleep that's not more than eight hours per night. [substeps] Adults ages 47 or older need 8.5 to 12 hours of sleep each night, and older people over 65 need 9 to 12 hours of quality sleep each night. Ending3: To get better sleep, create healthy sleep habits for yourself, such as not using a mobile device within an hour of bedtime or reading for a little bit before going to sleep every night. [substeps] If you're struggling to get an adequate amount of sleep every night, a power nap can help you recharge during the day. Ending4: The teen sleeping pattern, the period, and the seven day cycle in which teenagers sleep only 10 to 12 hours a night (5 to 8 hours a day) are considered sleep apnea (sleep paralysis). [substeps] It is recommended that teenagers sleep on a slept-in mattress, in order to improve their quality of sleep.

Answer format: ending1/ending2/ending3/ending4

Please choose the correct ending to complete the given sentence: Pets and Animals: [header] How to involve your kids in selecting a dog [title] Bring up the possibility of getting a dog. [step] For most kids the idea of getting a dog will be very exciting. Bring the issue up with your kids when they have time to get excited, ask questions, and generally freak out.

Ending1: Keep in mind that they may not be the most excited about the concept of having a dog, so it is important that you discuss the possibility with them a little bit before you. [substeps] For example, if you have your kids go shopping with a pet, they will probably say " i want a dog. Ending2: You could say " we are thinking about getting a dog. What do think about that idea? " [substeps] During that initial conversation you should bring up what your kids will have to do to care for the dog if they agree to get one. Ending3: When the kids are getting excited about picking a dog, talk it over so they can be ready for anything. [substeps] You can pick a puppy, or puppies, and realize you are still just under 10 years old and don't really understand the complexity of adopting. Ending4: Keep it clear with your kids that the notion of owning a dog is not a complete myth. [substeps] Instead of saying " if you can't afford a dog, but you're still willing to try one, why not give it a try? " let your kids know that the idea of a dog is exciting.

questions.instruction:
Please choose the correct ending to complete the given sentence: Finance and Business: [header] How to buy a house with friends [title] Determine what the agreement will cover. [step] A partnership agreement is a legal contract entered into when a group of individuals go in together on a joint venture. In this situation, the joint venture is buying a home.

Ending1: The partnership agreement will dictate how you and your friends will be required to interact when it comes to purchasing and living in the home. While you and your friends can agree to almost anything, if you fail to address certain issues, state laws (usually called uniform partnership acts) will fill in the blanks for you. Ending2: [substeps] A joint venture allows a large portion of the company's remaining revenue to be entered into as the term of the partnership. A joint venture is usually formed when everyone contributes to the plan, with a " positive " outcome at the end and usually lasts several months after the joint venture expires. Ending3: [substeps] Before making a partner's agreement, you should analyze the potential risks involved in buying the property. A limited liability company may only buy a share of the property and a sole proprietorship, the two companies can only purchase the property when they are certain it is in the best interest of the joint venture to make use of the full share. Ending4: A partnership agreement will provide the joint venture with terms like budgetary and money-management, as well as an agreement to allow the parties to lease the house to others. In addition, a partnership agreement requires the parties to be friends of one another.

Answer format: ending1/ending2/ending3/ending4
